'''4L4 fusial thrust engines''' were advanced [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] engines manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] for use aboard [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. As well as the T-65 models used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], these engines were also used on later models such as the [[T-65XJ3 X-wing starfighter|XJ3 X-wing]], which saw action during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

Four of these powerful engines were mounted on each X-wing, allowing for a maximum speed of 1,300 kilometers per hour in atmosphere, with even higher speeds possible with deflector shields on. In addition, engines of this type were often adapted with a system of [[etheric rudder]]s, allowing [[thrust vectoring]] and enhanced maneuverability. This maneuverability was so increased that pilots likened it to flying a [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] in atmospheric flight.

Next-generation X-wing models, such as the [[T-65XJ X-wing starfighter|XJ X-wing]], were equipped an even more advanced propulsion system&mdash;Incom [[4j.4 fusial thrust engine/Legends|4j.4 fusial thrust engines]]. Rated at 300 KTU, these engine units provided even more power than the 4L4s, allowing speeds comparable to that of the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]].
